title: APEX Protocol 1: low-volume heat shock transformation on the OT-2 thermocycler module

containers.name: plasmid_plate
containers.description: Plasmids pEX01-pEX08, one per well A1:H1

containers.name: transformation_plate
containers.description: Competent DH5alpha cells, 10 uL per well A1:H1, on the thermocycler module

steps.source_quote: Each transformation was carried out with 1 ul of DNA ... 10 ul of cells and 50 ul of SOC media ... Low Volume (LV) configuration (Figure 4 legend)
steps.note: Fresh tip per plasmid; block held at 4 C

steps.action: Thermocycler: 4 C 30 min, 42 C 30 s, back to 4 C
steps.source_quote: By default, DNA is incubated at 4 C for 30 minutes, heat shocked at 42 C for 30 seconds
50 ul of SOC media as per ... Low Volume (LV) configuration

steps.action: Thermocycler: recover at 37 C for 1 h
steps.source_quote: recovered with SOC medium at 37 C for 1 hour

assumptions: 8 transformations (pEX01-pEX08, as in Figure 4) in column 1
Competent cells are pre-dispensed by the operator onto the pre-chilled block (APEX loads cells and DNA offline)
Post-shock return to 4 C is not stated in the text; the reference cools to 4 C for 2 min
